V = App.Vector
for name, off in (("C1", 0.0), ("C2", 5000.0)):

o = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "P"); o.Shape = Part.makeBox(1, 1, 1, V(0, 0, 100))
o = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Q"); o.Shape = Part.makeBox(1, 1, 1, V(5, 0, 100))
result = len(doc.Objects)
